title: Panelo faces Senate impeachment court show-cause order over bias claims
summary: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court is set to issue a show-cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Atty. Paolo Panelo, presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court is set to issue a show-cause order against Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Atty. Paolo Panelo, presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero ordered on Friday. The motion to issue the order came from Senator-Judge Erwin Tulfo who took notice of Panelo’s remarks saying some senator-judges may be showing bias
